title: Edit section
existing: Changes show up on the start page as soon as you save.
missing: This section does not exist yet. Saving creates it, and it then shows up on the start page.
conflict: The section has been created elsewhere in the meantime. Reload the page to edit it.

hero.name: Name
hero.nameDescription: Shown large on the start page, the role below it.
hero.roleAccentDescription: Starts the role, in italics and colour, e.g. “Frontend”.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.title: Project name
projects.publishedDescription: When off, the project is a draft that only you see on the site while you are signed in.
projects.imagesDescription: They appear in the carousel in this order, the first one is the cover.
projects.descriptionHint: Bold, italic, lists and links. No headings, the project name already is one.
projects.tagsDescription: Short notes below the project name, e.g. “Work project” or the name of the company. Optional, at most 5.

seo.title: Title
seo.titleDescription: Shown in the browser tab and in search results, followed by the name of the site.
seo.descriptionDescription: The short text below the title in search results.
